result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally clipped content in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the screen edge) and a truncated restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section. These are minor-to-moderate layout/content clipping problems.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name and delivery fee partially clipped. While this can signal scrollability, the text truncation looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a fade/peek indicator so the partially visible card clearly communicates horizontal scrolling without awkwardly clipping the restaurant name mid-word.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section appears truncated/clipped ('Tokumaru Rame...'), cutting off the final letter against the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines or ellipsize gracefully with sufficient spacing from the rating badge so the full name is readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is acceptable for a scrollable row but lacks a visual scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade or scroll hint on the right edge to indicate more categories are available.
